parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SnapshotIds
parameters.description:
The snapshot IDs.

You can specify a maximum of 100 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-rc-snapshots --disk-id rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw0000 --snapshot-ids 'rcds-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcds-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_…_rcds-bp67acfmxazb6p0000' --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=test01 Key=testRC --instance-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeRCSnapshots --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testRC --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'example-string' --Tag.1.Value test01 --SnapshotIds 'rcds-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcds-bp67acfmxazb5p0000_,_…_rcds-bp67acfmxazb6p0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DiskId 'rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw0000'
